bass.tags: Experimental electronic and industrial percussion. The track features a heavily processed, distorted kick drum that functions as a melodic bass element, playing a syncopated rhythmic pattern. A metallic, resonant percussion hit with a short decay occurs on the off-beats. High-frequency digital noise bursts and glitch artifacts are layered over the low-end pulses. The tempo is 120 BPM. The sound design utilizes aggressive saturation and bit-crushing effects on the percussion hits. A subtle, low-pass filtered sub-bass layer follows the kick drum rhythm. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the distorted low-end transients and the sharp, industrial mid-range textures.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum with sub-bass tail, syncopated rhythm]
[metallic percussion hits on off-beats]

[Main Section]
[digital noise bursts and glitch artifacts]
[bit-crushed percussion layers]
[low-pass filtered sub-bass pulses]

drums.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar root notes with a saturated, overdriven tone. Drums feature a high-tempo d-beat pattern with a sharp, cracking snare and consistent eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The production is raw with high-frequency emphasis and short room reverb on the drums. Key of E minor. 180 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
drums.prompt:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, d-beat drum pattern]

[Verse 1]
[shouted male vocals]
Systematic lies [crash cymbal]
Feeding on the weak
No more compromise
The future's looking bleak [guitar slide]

[Chorus]
[full band intensity]
Break the chains (break the chains)
Rise above the noise
Break the chains (break the chains)
You have no other choice [feedback swell]

[Outro]
[rapid snare rolls]
Go! [final crash cymbal]

vocals.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive four-bar loop consisting of jazz-influenced seventh chords with a slight chorus effect and high-frequency roll-off. A sampled drum break features a muffled kick drum and a crisp, dry snare with a slight swing. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the guitar progression. A vinyl crackle texture persists throughout the arrangement. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C major. The arrangement maintains a consistent loop without dynamic shifts or bridge sections.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle, clean electric guitar playing jazz chords]

[Main Loop]
[sampled drum break enters, muffled kick, dry snare]
[sub-bass synth enters following guitar root notes]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[guitar loop fades with vinyl crackle]
